en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a large Gothic-style brick building with stepped gables and several slender spires, standing directly beside a canal. The facade is lined with tall windows and ornate stone details. Printed at the bottom margin are captions in French and English identifying the scene as 'La Maison du Franc' / 'The House of the Franc' in Bruges, along with a small number '12' at the left and a printer's monogram at the right.
